question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: chatter

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• Chatter means talking informally about unimportant matters. (महत्वहीन मामलों के बारे में अनौपचारिक रूप से बात करें)
 
• Fritter means to waste time, money, or energy on trifling matters. (तुच्छ मामलों पर समय, पैसा या ऊर्जा बर्बाद करना)
 
• Rattle means to make or cause to make a rapid succession of short, sharp knocking sounds. (छोटी, तेज खटखट की आवाजों का तेजी से उत्तराधिकार बनाना या बनाना)
 
• Patter means making a repeated light tapping sound. (बार-बार हल्की टैपिंग ध्वनि करें)
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: The conversation ended as our host began to read.
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words, "chatter" should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *Our host started to read and the **(1) chatter __**stopped. There was a sweet (2)_______ as each person read, not one that felt forced or imposed in any way. People did not seem to (3)_______ or cough, but perhaps that is just now I remember it now, I know I was increasingly self-conscious as the readings came closer to me and that when it was my turn I think I (4)________ through most of it, probably without making any sense of the (5)_________.*
